title: Tasks v2
summary: Long-running tools as tasks (SEP-2663). Start a slow job and watch it poll, answer a task that stops to ask for input, or cancel one.
about: Tools that run as tasks (SEP-2663). A call returns a task ID, and the page polls tasks/get until it finishes.
slow_compute runs for as many seconds as you ask. Cancel it partway with the Cancel button.
confirm_delete stops and asks you to confirm, and your answer goes back with tasks/update.
failing_job and protocol_error_job show the two ways a task can fail.
